content.tagline: Confirm then fill the hiring form

gallery.caption: The password lives only in this session

features.name: Local vault
features.subtitle: The key stays on this computer
features.description: Resume files, structured records, and site rules stay encrypted on device. There is no account and no cloud copy to leak.

features.name: Import review
features.subtitle: Parse is only a draft
features.description: PDF and DOCX are read locally into candidate fields. Unchecked values never enter the fillable profile.

features.name: Confirmed fill
features.subtitle: See it then write it
features.description: Preview shows page field, profile field, and proposed value. Nothing is written until you confirm, and the extension never submits.

features.name: Job variants
features.subtitle: Same facts different wording
features.description: The master profile keeps identity facts. Variants override summary, intent, and descriptions instead of cloning the whole resume.

features.name: Site rules
features.subtitle: Correct once remember next time
features.description: Mapping fixes are stored per site on this machine. If the page changes enough, the rule falls back to confirmation instead of silent fills.

principles.title: Nothing leaves this device
principles.description: Parsing, encryption, and mapping run in the extension. Permissions are only activeTab, scripting, and storage.

principles.title: Fill never submit
principles.description: The extension can write inputs and highlight results. Submit, login, and captcha stay in your hands.

principles.title: Mappings stay explainable
principles.description: Every preview shows page label to profile field to proposed value. Low confidence and conflicts stay unchecked.

principles.title: Fills can be undone
principles.description: Original values are kept before writing. Undo works if the page structure is unchanged; otherwise you get a warning.

principles.title: Sensitive fields stay off
principles.description: Phone and email matches are not selected by default. Referees and compliance statements require an explicit opt-in.

benefits: An encrypted vault that stays on this computer
PDF and DOCX import that waits for review
Preview, confirmed fill, highlight, and undo
Site rules that remember mappings you correct
Job variants that override only the differences
pricing.terms: Distributed today as a local trial pack, not a store listing. Source is Apache-2.0. A forgotten master password can only be recovered by wiping local data.

faq.q: How is this different from Autofill or a job site parser?
faq.a: Autofill stores logins. Site parsers often upload the file. Offer-Nail keeps a structured vault on this computer and writes the current page only after you confirm.
Yes. The source is Apache-2.0. You build the Chrome and Edge trial packs yourself.

faq.q: Will it submit applications for me?
faq.a: No. It fills fields you confirm. You still press submit.
Only activeTab, scripting, and storage. It does not ask for permanent access to every site.

faq.q: Can I import a scanned resume?
faq.a: No. PDFs without a text layer are not OCR'd. Enter those fields by hand.

faq.q: Is it on the Chrome Web Store?
faq.a: Not yet. Build the unpacked directory from the repo and load it at chrome://extensions.
Anyone who needs cloud sync, Firefox or Safari, or unattended mass apply. It also does not promise every custom widget on every ATS.
